promises.label: Cut menu complexity by 30%
promises.commitment: Reduce both beverage and food SKUs by roughly 30% by the end of FY2025.
promises.outcomeSummary: Starbucks reported a 25% SKU reduction in fiscal year 2025; roughly 30% reductions in both beverages and food were not substantiated.

promises.label: Scale Green Apron Service
promises.commitment: Start scaling Green Apron Service to more than 2,000 US company-operated locations in May; reach more than one-third of US coffeehouses by FY2025 year-end.
promises.outcomeSummary: The May rollout reached more than 2,000 company-operated U.S. coffeehouses; full U.S. company-operated deployment followed in August, exceeding original coverage.

summaryErrors: The claim that the May rollout reached more than 2,000 U.S. company-operated coffeehouses is not established by the sources. The April 29 statement promised scaling beginning in May, not completion at more than 2,000 locations during May. On July 29, management described a 1,500-store test; it subsequently confirmed full U.S. company-operated deployment in August.

missing.what_was_said: Management said it had accelerated the rollout well ahead of schedule because of strong pilot results, describing the pilot as an eight-week, 1,500-store test. This distinguishes demonstrated pilot coverage from the earlier expansion target.
Management explicitly confirmed the delivery month: “August was a milestone as we went live with the new standard across our full US company-operated portfolio.”
missing.call: Q4 and Full Fiscal Year 2025 earnings call

promises.label: Complete 1,000 coffeehouse uplifts
promises.commitment: Complete at least 1,000 coffeehouse uplifts across North America by the end of calendar 2026.
promises.outcomeSummary: By fiscal year-end, Starbucks completed more than 1,700 North America uplifts, exceeding both its original 1,000 commitment and raised 1,500 target.

missing.what_was_said: Management said: “In Q3, we surpassed 1,000 total uplifts across North America, reaching our fiscal 2026 goal ahead of plan.” This completion announcement preceded the increase to the 1,500 target on the same call.

promises.label: Close China joint venture
promises.commitment: Close the Boyu Capital China retail joint venture in spring 2026, retaining 40% ownership while Boyu acquires up to 60%.
promises.outcomeSummary: Spring target met: transaction closed March 30, 2026, announced April 2, 2026; Boyu acquired 60%, Starbucks retained 40%.

missing.what_was_said: Management confirmed that the Boyu transaction closed shortly after fiscal quarter-end and that Starbucks China's retail operations would be deconsolidated beginning in Q3 and reported within its licensed portfolio.

promises.label: Capture $2 billion cost savings
promises.commitment: Capture about $2 billion of cost savings unfolding over the next two years, building on work begun in 2025.
promises.outcomeSummary: Over 50% of the $2 billion gross savings program achieved; management remained on track, with savings continuing through fiscal 2028.
